[[File:Signaltranceivers.png|thumb|right|250px|Signal transceivers on a TIE fighter]]
'''Signal transceivers''' were devices that could be attached to a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] and allow its [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to tell friendlies from enemies. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] mounted them onto four stolen [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] that four pilots would be using to infiltrate a [[Secret armada|secret Imperial armada]], so that they could distinguish each other from the actual [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]]. However, during the [[Battle of the secret armada]], the Rebels' signal transceivers were [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]]. [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was forced to rely on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
